en: Black‑and‑white image showing a tall baroque-style church tower with a clock and onion-shaped dome rising above attached buildings with steep gabled roofs. In the foreground are trees, a fence enclosing a garden or yard, and a dirt path where three people—two adults and a child—stand, one adult holding a bicycle. The overall composition and border suggest an early 20th‑century postcard view of a small European town church.
